title: Outside lanes preflight the receiver before a paid session starts
body:
Evidence (verified 2026-11-17): .krn/runs/{pilot,pilot-py,units-ts,units-py}/lanes/summary.txt hold 50 outside lane attempts: 20 exit 0, 30 nonzero (74 x9 red check, 72 x9, 65 x5, 73 x3, 64 x2, 69 x2). Each failed attempt spent a paid model session before a receiver setup problem surfaced (red baseline, missing required gate, workflow permissions per .krn/runs/outside/summary.txt).
Outcome: a lane on an outside repository runs a preflight (baseline test green, required Check configured and reachable, App/workflow permissions) before the model session starts; a failed preflight exits with a named code and launches no session.
Proof: a test with a red baseline and one with a missing required Check each assert zero session launches and the named exit; the next 10 pilot attempts have no exit 72/73/64 after a launched session.
